stories.title: Distance Calculation Contract and Data Schema
stories.description: Define strict Pydantic schema for distance inputs/outputs including lat/lng validation, unit normalization, and standardized response fields (distance_meters, duration_seconds, source, status).

stories.title: Core Distance Calculation Logic
stories.description: Refactor and extract reusable distance computation logic from clinical_trials_service into a shared service using Google Routes, including null-safe handling and fallback behavior when API responses are missing or fail.

stories.title: Service Integration with Provider and Trial Flows
stories.description: Integrate the shared distance service into provider search and clinical trials flows to ensure consistent enrichment of results with distance and duration fields across both domains.

stories.title: Distance Calculation API Exposure
stories.description: Expose the distance calculation service via internal service interfaces and tool router contracts to enable reuse across facades with standardized error handling and response formatting.

stories.title: Distance Calculation Tests and Edge Case Validation
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering valid calculations, edge cases (zero distance, invalid coordinates, identical points), and Google Routes failure scenarios to ensure robustness.
